title: Incident briefing surface and adjustable SLO anchors
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact incident briefing surface that surfaces a focused set of signals (SLO deltas, top-error spans, estimated cost delta, recent runbook links) and introduces adjustable SLO anchors: temporary slider controls that let on-call responders simulate threshold changes in-line to see how alert sensitivity and run-rate would change before creating a follow-up change or incident postmortem note.
background: On-call responders frequently need a lightweight way to understand whether an alert is noise or a signal, how close the system is to SLO breach, and what an immediate mitigation would mean to alert volume and cost. Current alert/detail pages are dense; we need a compact surface for quick triage and a safe simulation UI for short-term threshold tuning.
goals: Provide a single-line incident briefing that fits in the incident list and a richer expanded pane
Allow responders to preview SLO threshold changes using an adjustable anchor (slider) without affecting production configuration
Surface quick links to the last postmortem, related runbook snippets, and the most recent deploy/rollout
Show an estimated short-term cost delta when toggling mitigations (eg. scale-up vs degrade fallback)
Support copyable summary text for postmortem templates
scope: Design compact briefing card (collapsed) and expanded briefing pane
Prototype SLO anchor slider with simulated recalculation of alert counts and breach probability
Inline links to postmortem, playbooks, and recent deploys
Cost delta micro-visual and explanation tooltip
non_goals: Persisting any SLO changes via the slider (no config mutation)
Replacing the full incident timeline or runbook editor
Automated mitigation actions (only simulation and manual links to actions)
design_decisions: Use a two-tier surface: collapsed badge (one-line) and an expandable pane with 3 columns: signals, simulation, actions
SLO anchor slider is ephemeral; we show a bright yellow ‘Preview’ and require an explicit ‘Apply to Policy’ CTA that routes to the alert edit flow
Estimate cost delta calculated using the last 15 minutes of traffic and chosen mitigation profile (rounded and shown as a range)
Include a compact postmortem link that pre-populates a summary snippet with templated fields (time, SLO delta, mitigation tried) for copy-paste into an actual postmortem doc
tradeoffs_considered: Real-time recalculation vs. cached estimates: chose cached short-window (15m) recalcs to avoid spamming the simulation engine
Ephemeral sliders vs. in-place editing: ephemeral slider prevents accidental policy drift but requires an extra click to apply changes
Card density vs. scannability: removed flamecharts from the briefing pane in favor of a single top-error-span line to keep the pane compact
prototypes: Prototype notes: Artboards include collapsed list, expanded pane, slider interaction states, and 'Apply to Policy' confirmation modal
engineering_notes: Backend: need a lightweight endpoint /alerts/:id/simulate-slo that returns estimated alert count and cost delta for a given anchor value
Estimate compute: cache 15m series and reuse existing SLO evaluation lambda; avoid running expensive rollup queries on quick slider moves
Telemetry: track slider opens, previews, and 'Apply to Policy' clicks to measure usefulness
Accessibility: slider must be keyboard operable and offer numeric input for exact anchor values
review_feedback: PM (Ibrahim): love the briefing-first approach; ask to show 'probability of breach' as a percent and to include downstream customer-facing routes
Eng (Priya): backend simulation endpoint okay, but request rate-limiting and debounce on the UI side; wants clear contract on acceptable latency (<= 450ms cached response)
Design (Lucia): prefer microcopy for the cost delta tooltip to explain assumptions (time window, instance pricing tier) and request soft warning color when cost delta > $100/h
SRE (Jon): request link to recent deploy and commit hash in the expanded pane for quick rollback context
accessibility_considerations: High-contrast color choices for the slider and status chips
Aria-live region for dynamic simulation results so screen readers announce recalculated numbers
Numeric input adjacent to slider for users who cannot manipulate sliders
open_questions: Exact business rule for cost delta rounding (dollars vs percentage) - finance wants percentage in reports
Should the collapsed briefing card surface a 1-line summary of the selected mitigation? (adds complexity to list rendering)
How do we reconcile multiple SLOs per service in the briefing pane—prioritize primary SLO, or allow toggling between SLOs?

Expanded pane shows slider simulation with recalculated breach probability and estimated cost delta
Slider is non-destructive and requires explicit 'Apply to Policy' to change any persisted alert config
Prototype validated by at least 6 on-call engineers with >= 4/6 reporting improved triage speed
Backend simulation endpoint responds within 450ms for cached requests and is rate-limited
